sources.snippet: Closing Thoughts LLM tokens, parameters, and weights form the core structure of any LLM. These elements define how well an AI model understands, processes, and generates language. Finally, by understanding how LLMs function, developers, businesses, and everyday users can make better decisions with AI technology.
